requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a legible, indelible trade name/mark and type designation; pass if both are present and survive a rub test.

requirements.text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check that either an R37/R99/R128 approval number for the LED light source or a Technical Service report of mechanical non-interchangeability is available.

requirements.text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
requirements.test_case: Review the R10 test report for the representative lamp; pass if all paragraph 6. requirements are met.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the production lamp for an R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3.; pass if present (unless approved as part of a vehicle unit).

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp for a circle with letter E and the approving country's number.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number placed to the right of the E-circle.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify by R10 ESA test results and design review that the lamp electronics allow the vehicle to meet R10 in normal use.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp test report covers radiated emissions, conducted emissions, radiated immunity and conducted immunity tests with pass results.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows broadband radiated emission measured per the Annex 7 method.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if below the log-decreasing 62 to 52 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if below the log-increasing 52 to 63 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare broadband measured values with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if below the log-decreasing 52 to 42 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if below the log-increasing 42 to 53 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Check transient conducted emission tested per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emission per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses do not exceed +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check radiated immunity tested using one or more Annex 9 methods.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify test plan applies Table 2a and Table 2b severities for the chosen Annex 9 method.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify BCI injection current of 60 mA (>90 %) and minimum 50 mA over 20-400 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range and 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz and 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify ALSE field levels 30/10 V/m (>90 %) and minimum 25/8 V/m in the respective bands with no degradation.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify TEM cell field levels of 75 V/m (>90 %) and minimum 62,5 V/m over 20-200 MHz with no degradation.

requirements.text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review circuit documentation; if no oscillator >9 kHz, narrowband test may be waived.

requirements.text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Monitor lamp functions during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check conducted transient immunity tested per ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10 at Tables 3a and 3b levels.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify starting profile results are classified per ISO 16750-1 functional status.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify pulse results are classified per ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V / -450 V for 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III is reached.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V / -150 V for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (other) is reached.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses; pass if the functional status class meets B/D/C as applicable.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the electromagnetic broadband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the electromagnetic broadband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 75-400 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the electromagnetic narrowband radiation emitted by the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth, as referenced in paragraph 6.6.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with a 120 kHz bandwidth and verify all readings are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test setup and report to confirm a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 was used for the LV supply of the ESA.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the broadband radiated emission test was performed per CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that all lamp functions were energised in normal operation mode at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test setup in the report follows the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation, which are for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Check that, where peak detection was used, the 20 dB correction factor was applied in the limit comparison.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the narrowband emission test was carried out to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission tests.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan and report: lamp functions are operated in normal mode with maximum load (all functions lit) during measurement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test setup in the report matches the CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 ALSE arrangement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions over 30-1,000 MHz; all readings below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Verify the receiver settings in the report use an average detector.

requirements.text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2), TEM cell testing (ISO 11452-3), bulk current injection testing (ISO 11452-4), stripline testing (ISO 11452-5) or reverberation chamber test (ISO 11452-11), at the manufacturer's discretion, only provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm the selected methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of the ESA shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report states that frequency range and general conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the ESA shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report documents test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm during testing that the lamp functions are powered and operating normally.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up against the Annex 9 arrangement or the chosen ISO method.

requirements.text: Measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Check test generator settings: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth over 20-400 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Check test generator settings: PM2, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700-3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Check test generator settings: PM3, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380-2,700 and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify step size and dwell time in the report comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.test_case: On failure, check field monitoring confirms failure occurred under controlled test conditions.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Verify the field calibration used the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: When the absorber chamber test is used, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Check antenna orientation is vertical in the test report.

requirements.text: When TEM cell testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Verify the TEM cell test report references ISO 11452-3.

requirements.text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, or alternatively with the ESA installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with substitution method and injection probe at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify BCI set-up method and probe distance (150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed loop) in the report.

requirements.text: When the reverberation chamber test is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Verify the reverberation chamber test report references ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply and supply-connected lines and verify the required functional status per Table 3b.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines and verify the functional status class per Table 3a, unless the lamp is documented as EV-only.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions of the lamp on its supply lines per ISO 7637-2 and confirm they are within the Regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting on the vehicle after vibration/normal-use conditions and verify the lamp retains its prescribed characteristics and position.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be fitted such that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fixing design and attempt to displace the lamp by hand; verify no inadvertent misalignment is possible.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp relative to the road bearing plane; deviation within ±3°.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; deviation within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the orientation of the reference axis of light-signalling devices, in each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
requirements.test_case: Verify measured axis deviations in horizontal and vertical directions do not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation with the manufacturer's fitting instructions; all instructions followed.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure lamp height and orientation.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral positions of the left and right lamps from the median longitudinal plane based on exterior form; verify symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare exterior geometry of left and right hand lamps; verify mirror symmetry (interior structure excluded).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps; verify both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps for each function; verify substantially identical values.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect rear lamps for logos; verify at most two lateral or one central logo on the rear.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp; verify it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: For each grouped/combined function in the lamp, verify colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements individually.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF; verify compliance.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function together and measure the colour of the other function; verify compliance.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected distinct parts; verify area ratio >= 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral or gap between facing edges <= 75 mm.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front, per paragraph 5.10.4.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground of a lamp shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above ground and compare to the height limits.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are claimed, measure the lamp height from the H plane and verify eligibility.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp function continuously and verify intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry in each varying operating state and confirm all values remain within the device approval provisions.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observe from Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle (Annex 4) and confirm no direct view of the red lamps' apparent surfaces.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the red light intensity emitted towards the front, including vehicle body influence, and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and verify front/rear position, marker and registration plate lamps switch ON and OFF together.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the function ON and OFF and verify all light sources of the interdependent lamp system change state simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are not concealable.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the retro-reflected light and confirm it is red.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count installed rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare with the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: For lamps on movable components, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Place the movable component in each fixed position and verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in non-normal positions, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (e.g. glare) to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position each time.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Place each movable component in each fixed position and measure that no more than 50 % of the apparent surface of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors is hidden.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that each lamp function operates without further action than installation of light source and/or fuse.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed only provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function's colour, intensity and position, and that the replacement device keeps its original function.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure and confirm the dashboard tell-tale indicates temporary replacement.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are allowed only provided that the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities of variable-intensity lamps across the control range and confirm they vary together proportionally.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio during transitions and confirm the prescribed ratio is maintained.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition of the variable luminous intensity lamps.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity over time during transitions and confirm no sharp step changes.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage at constant vehicle voltage operating condition and compare with the approved voltage.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage under constant voltage operating condition and confirm it is not more than 3 per cent above 13.5 V (12 V system).

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that no vehicle part obstructs light within the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility measurement method uses parallel-shifted observation directions when measuring close to the lamp.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric measurement with the obstructing parts simulated and confirm compliance with device photometric values.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify approval marks/certificates (R148 for position, stop, reversing; R150 for retro-reflector) are present for each function.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present (mandatory) on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps fitted on the M1 vehicle and confirm there are one or two.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark for the reversing function.

requirements.text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle and confirm it is within 250-1,200 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface is unobstructed over 15° up/5° down and 45° left/right using geometric visibility measurement.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify each lamp's apparent surface is unobstructed over 15° up/5° down, 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm that the reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Perform a functional test: the lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and the propulsion system operable.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse gear or switch off the propulsion system and confirm that the lamp goes off and cannot be switched on.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the R148 approval documentation; if failure indication is required, simulate a failure and verify the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark on the stop lamp for a valid UN R7 (02+ series) or UN R148 (00+ series) approval.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamp devices on the vehicle; pass if exactly two are installed.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350 mm to 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by bodywork).

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle installation; pass if the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface over 45° left and right; pass if visible across the full range.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface over 15° above and below horizontal.

requirements.text: For the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify inward visibility under the H plane of at least 20°.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

requirements.text: The orientation of the stop lamps shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the stop lamp reference axis points towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the braking signal and observe; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be present (mandatory).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle has two rear position lamps bearing a valid R7 (02+) or R148 (00+) approval mark.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of rear position lamp apparent surface to vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in height above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp apparent surface height per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350–1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamps are at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of rear position lamp apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of rear position lamp over 15° above and below horizontal.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamps, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If mounting height < 750 mm, verify inward visibility under the H plane of at least 20°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, where for a lamp mounted below 750 mm the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If alternative applied, confirm rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify visibility 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the limit angles, excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear position lamps shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring against paragraph 5.11 (switching together with front position lamps etc.); pass if compliant.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be provided for the rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and check that the closed-circuit tell-tale lights.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check that one combined tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps (except when DRL are ON).

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and verify that the failure tell-tale activates where required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be present on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle rear for the presence of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and bear Class IA or IB approval marks under UN R3 (02+) or UN R150 (00+).

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost illuminating-surface point to the vehicle outer edge; pass if not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height of the retro-reflector above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if 250 mm to 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped, 1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards on the vehicle.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify that the rear position lamps switch ON.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure flash frequency and phase; pass if in phase and 3.0-5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on and off and verify it operates independently.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.test_case: Verify by vehicle test that the signal activates and deactivates without manual control.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Perform emergency braking below and above 50 km/h; pass if the signal is activated only above 50 km/h with the logic signal present.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
requirements.test_case: Remove the logic signal or activate the hazard warning signal during operation; pass if the emergency stop signal switches OFF automatically.

requirements.text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Check from observer positions between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground in zone 1 (front) that no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
requirements.test_case: Construct the 15° outward planes through the overall-width contact points and verify no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible within zone 1.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify that each function in the combination unit (rear position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector) holds or meets the applicable Regulation's provisions.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check that no function in the unit lacks compliance with an applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing/sample for a marking space large enough for all required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub test; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval marking; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for circle with letter E and the country distinguishing number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Verify the sequential number is located adjacent to the E-mark circle.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Verify the marking includes the function symbols per Table 1 (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR).

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Verify marking shows "148R" followed by the series of amendments digits.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect handed lamp marking for a horizontal arrow indicating mounting side.

requirements.text: In the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the rear position lamp points outwards from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the reversing lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp sample for presence of the approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for marking of the prescribed light source categories.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for code starting with MD followed by the approval mark without circle.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Verify the marking is on a part not separable from the light-emitting lens.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Check on vehicle that the approval marking is visible as fitted or with boot lid/door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect both detachable lens and main body for the approval marking.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body; it bears only the markings of its own functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for presence of all listed markings on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations bear a single approval mark, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp in installed position on the vehicle; the single approval mark must be visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check the mark location (e.g. on the outer lens) and verify that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes required by the pertinent Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5 are verified as met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the applicable R48 section 5 and 6 requirements for the lamp are assessed at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Verify that R48 requirements pertinent to rear position, stop and reversing lamps for M1 vehicles (e.g. geometric visibility) are checked where feasible at lamp approval.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Assess design and perform vibration/durability checks followed by photometric and colorimetric re-measurement; characteristics must remain within limits.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design: verify multiple light sources provide the functions or that the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the stop lamp and reversing lamp optics and lens; no logo shall be present within their apparent surfaces.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review LED wiring diagram to identify groups treated as one light source for the failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minimum (and maxima with all sources on), or verify a failure tell-tale activation signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within category R1 limits.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review BOM and design to confirm the LED light sources are non-replaceable, light source modules, or UN-approved replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in incorrect orientations; fitting shall only be possible in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.
requirements.test_case: Check holder dimensions against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission tests (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt fitting in other positions and removal without tools; both shall be impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module design for tamperproof construction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit UN approved light sources in the module seat; must not be possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different functions within the housing; must not be possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another having the same identification code and re-measure photometry; requirements must be met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with particulars of the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the photometric and colorimetric test reports state measurement per paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review test report; pass if all photometric measurements were made with the LED light sources fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect photometric test setup; pass if masking is applied to prevent stray reflections.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test setup that the light sources are continuously lit during intensity measurement.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Review test report/drawings; pass if the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction are determined for each function.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure supply voltage at the lamp terminals during testing; pass if 6.75 V, 13.5 V or 28 V according to the system voltage.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp is operated during tests according to the applicant's specified operating conditions.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp is operated during tests according to the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV on both samples for each function; pass if not less than the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity over all visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at the Annex 3 grid points; pass if each is at least the minimum times the specified percentage or the specified value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity throughout the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if not below the specified minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions; pass if compliant.
