requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure both lamps on and position lamp alone within ±5° V / ±10° H; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review test report; pass if luminous intensity compliance was assessed per Annex 8.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid for each function; pass if within the specified colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Review colorimetric test report; pass if paragraph 4.8 test conditions were applied.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour measurements were made with the LED sources fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4: minimum luminous intensity 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), maximum luminous intensity 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and angles of geometric visibility as defined in Table A2-1 with minimum luminous intensity 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples: pass if HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 17 cd (8.5 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid met and ≥ 0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4: minimum luminous intensity 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), maximum luminous intensity 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and angles of geometric visibility as defined in Table A2-1 with minimum luminous intensity 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples: pass if HV ≥ 4 cd, max ≤ 42 cd (21 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid met and ≥ 0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted only below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensity below 5° down; pass if ≤ 60 cd there and Table 4 maximum elsewhere.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity within Table A2-1 angles; pass if ≥ 0.05 cd throughout.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Assess lamp against paragraph 4.6 failure provisions; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamps shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp within the grid; pass if within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all values within the Table 7 limits for the declared category.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis, at the Figure A3-I grid and over the Table A2-1 field; minimum ≥60 cd, maximum ≤260 cd (≤130 cd if marked "D"), ≥0.3 cd within geometric visibility.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp and 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure in day and night conditions; minimum ≥60 cd, maximum ≤730 cd (≤365 cd if marked "D"), ≥0.3 cd (day) / ≥0.07 cd (night) within geometric visibility.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity over the Table A2-1 geometric visibility field; values not below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6; lamp behaviour complies with paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd and the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-V, as specified in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and at the Figure A3-V grid points; minimum ≥80 cd and grid values per Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, as specified in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity in all zones; ≤300 cd at/above H, ≤600 cd from H to 5°D, ≤8000 cd below 5°D.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at 30° inwards; value ≥25 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp light through the lens; chromaticity within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamp (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surface visibility of the rear position lamp across horizontal angles and confirm it is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamp (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: For front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane from 20° inboard to 80° outboard and above the H-plane from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: For front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility from 15° above to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: For stop lamps (S1, S2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane, as given in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with H-plane below 750 mm, verify visibility below the H-plane from 20° inboard to 45° outboard and above the H-plane from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis, which passes through the centre of reference; the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Check that the minimum intensity per measuring direction is calculated as the given percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and that the measured values meet it.

requirements.text: In the case where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm and verify the rear position lamp photometry down to 5° below horizontal only.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at intermediate directions within each grid cell and verify each value is at least the lowest minimum percentage on the surrounding grid lines.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Where visual inspection shows local intensity variations, measure the reversing lamp between measuring directions and verify no value is below 50% of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 4).
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement of the rear position lamp at all Figure A3-I points; each value shall be at least the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd, the directions H = 0° and V = 0° corresponding to the axis of reference and passing through the centre of reference.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement of the reversing lamp at all Figure A3-V points; each value shall be at least the minimum intensity in cd given.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure (or calculate via HV ratio) the reversing lamp intensity distribution after 1 min and 10 min of operation and confirm all points are within the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps and stop lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure (or calculate via HV ratio) the rear position and stop lamp intensity distributions after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability and confirm all points are within the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For front and rear position lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity of the rear position lamp at 4 s after switch ON, scale the distribution by the HV ratio and confirm compliance with minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity of the reversing lamp at 0.2 s after switch ON, scale the distribution by the HV ratio and confirm compliance with minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the function uses LED only and that values measured per paragraph 1.2. comply with the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector holds its own UN R150 approval, separate from the lamp function approvals.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device and confirm the approval number is marked in accordance with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflective device shall be IA for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) or IB for a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight), with a minimum "a" of 5 mm, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the marked class symbol matches the retro-reflector class (IA or IB) and that 'a' is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawings and samples to confirm a marking space large enough for the UI or the approval marking and the other markings.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the markings for legibility and carry out a rub/durability test for indelibility.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking and confirm 'a' is at least the Table 1 value (5 mm for IA/IB).

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding 'E' and the country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the 4-6 digit sequential number is present and positioned close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the class symbol (IA or IB) is present in the approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Verify that '150R' followed by the series digits (e.g. 01) is present in the marking.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If a UI is used, compare its format with Figure I.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, retro-reflective devices shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If the rotation angle is not unambiguous, check that 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflective device to confirm all markings are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with several UN Regulations carry a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier, this marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed, check that the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps carry a single approval mark, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Check by design review and disassembly that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare them with the minimum sizes of the individual regulations.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed, shall be applied where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions for M1 rear retro-reflectors that can be verified at component approval and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect samples and review results of the full test sequence; the retro-reflector functions satisfactorily throughout.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual and design inspection of samples; no defects detrimental to operation or maintenance are found.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector; it can be easily cleaned.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; no roughness and no protuberances preventing cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; the inner surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: Where retro-reflectors consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the construction; optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Review material specification and inspect parts; colour is achieved in the material, not by paint or varnish.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of retro-reflected light; they lie within the R48 night-time red boundaries.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the colorimetric test report states Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0° (or Annex 4 angle).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5; all requirements met.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric tests; results meet paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Perform physical and mechanical tests per 5.1.7.; all are passed.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Subject samples to Annex 6 Part 1 heat test, then after ≥1 h verify colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Perform water penetration test and then fuel and lubricant resistance tests on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Perform corrosion test (if applicable) and rear-face abrasion test on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Perform Annex 4 Part 3 stability test on two samples; optical properties remain compliant.

requirements.text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Perform Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour of each group's samples after testing; coordinates within the 5.1.5 limits.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after testing; values meet 5.1.4 minima.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Check the illuminating surface used for photometry lies within a 200 mm circle and does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at 20' divergence; RI ≥ 300/200/100 mcd/lx at the specified angles.

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle; no value falls below the corresponding Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm intended mounting height; if below 750 mm, RI verified down to 5° downwards and compliant.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the colour test report references the paragraph 4.2.1 method.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reflected flux; coordinates within the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm that the tests on samples a to j were performed in the sequence of Table 4.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h and inspect them visually; no distortion is allowed.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to photometry as per Part 1 of Annex 4, limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL at 20' observation angle and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must meet the specified minimum.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, two samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to complete photometry as per Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Perform full photometry on two samples at all specified angles; all values must meet the requirements.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6 for 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the samples for 10 min upright and 10 min inverted, then inspect for water penetration and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, all samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to a visual inspection of the general specifications.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against the general specifications of paragraph 4; no non-conformity is allowed.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, all samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to a visual inspection of the shapes and dimensions as per Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect all ten samples for shape and dimensions against Annex 5; all samples must comply.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, after the heat test the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates measured in case of doubt.
requirements.test_case: Visually check the colour after heat exposure and measure the trichromatic coordinates if in doubt; the result must be within the limits of paragraph 4.2.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to the test fuel for 5 min and inspect visually; no visible surface alteration is allowed.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7 for 5 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to the test oil for 5 min, inspect them visually and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours), followed by visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Run salt spray for 24 h, pause 2 h, then run a further 24 h and inspect visually; no corrosion that impairs performance is allowed.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the samples of the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the rear face test of Part 4 of Annex 6 for 1 min, followed by visual inspection, colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Apply the rear face test for 1 min, inspect visually and recheck colour and photometry; all results must comply.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: After the stability in time exposure, check colour and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must remain within limits.

requirements.text: In accordance with Table 4, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry as per paragraph 4.2 (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: After the weathering exposure, check colour and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; the values must remain within limits.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector about its reference axis at β = 0°, α = 20', find minimum RI and verify it meets the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, and if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at all other specified angles with the device fixed at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify compliance.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices marked "TOP", the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the ±5° rotation about their axes.
requirements.test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation; pass if no reading falls below the prescribed value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its axis at β = 0°, α = 20' while measuring RI.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle of Classes IIIA/IIIB.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector sample at 65 °C ± 2 °C dry for 48 h, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and record conditions as per procedure.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after heat conditioning; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the device for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the illuminating surface top 20 mm below the surface.

requirements.text: The water immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device inverted, rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect after immersion; pass if no water is present on the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after immersion; any clearly visible water means failure.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Shake off excess water and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if RI meets the paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. criteria.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB, as an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Part 3 of Annex 6 shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the manufacturer's request and that both the moisture and dust tests were performed.

requirements.text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in paragraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.6.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows the initial RI measured and recorded before the water spray test.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Check that the position, stop and reversing lamps were operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the spray test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Tap and tilt the device after draining; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; record and compare with the initial RI.

requirements.text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as specified in paragraphs 2.3.5 to 2.3.7.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows the initial RI measured and recorded before dust exposure.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare with the initial RI.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the ISO 9227:2017 corrosion test and verify that photometric and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration after the corrosion test; no deterioration is permitted.

requirements.text: The testing of resistance to corrosion of the retro-reflective devices shall be as described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report references corrosion testing per ISO 9227:2017.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Verify the combined lamp, stripped of removable parts, is exposed to saline mist 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Check test records for a 5% NaCl solution atomized at 35 °C ± 2 °C with distilled water ≤0.02% impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare with Tables 9 and 10.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Verify the reverse side is brushed with a hard nylon brush as the first step of the rear face resistance test.

requirements.text: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the brushed rear face for 1 min, then remove and let dry.

requirements.text: The RI of the retro-reflective device shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: Cover the mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; values must meet the requirements.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Review the weathering test report; pass if exposure followed EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with the Table A6-1 parameters.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples in the xenon tester and verify the logged exposure duration is 500 hours.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for the resistance to fuels test of a retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test mixture composition is 70 vol.% n-heptane and 30 vol.% toluol before the fuel resistance test.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the surface about five minutes after wiping; pass if no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the n-heptane/toluol mixture and record the procedure.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI after the oil test per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and confirm it meets the limits set there.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflector lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil; confirm the step is recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes of exposure to the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the retro-reflector surface; confirm timing and cleaning are recorded.

requirements.text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm that the approval number is placed close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm that the digits of the approval number have the same orientation as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm that the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number with respect to the circle.
